company: HSIE Results Daily: Astra Microwave Products
headline: HSIE Results Daily: Astra Microwave Products-2QFY27

highlights: HSIE Research is also available on Bloomberg ERH HDF <GO> & Thomson Reuters 16 November 2026 HSIE Results Daily HSIE Results Daily Contents Results Reviews ■ Astra Microwave Products: AMPL recorded a robust Q2FY27 performance, reflected in the 22% YoY revenue growth to INR 2,628mn, led by healthy execution and the clearance of orders pending in Q1FY27 due to technical design-related customer approvals.
EBITDA margin surged to 33.4% (+1110bps YoY) due to superior execution and operating leverage.
The company’s standalone order book is at INR 39.4bn, supported by order inflows of INR 20.4bn in Q2FY27.
In Jul’26, AMPL bagged a large order worth INR 18.9bn from HAL for AAAU chips, with a delivery timeline of five years.
valuation: We maintain valuation multiple and raise the TP to INR 1,500 (40x FY29E EPS); however, we retain REDUCE due to the elevated valuation.
